figures.caption: Helical wheel projections of the peptides. By default the output presents the hydrophilic residues as circles, hydrophobic residues as diamonds, and potentially positively charged as pentagons. Hydrophobicity is color-coded as well: the most hydrophobic residue is green, and the amount of green decreases proportionally to the hydrophobicity, with zero hydrophobicity coded as yellow. Hydrophilic residues are coded red, with pure red being the most hydrophilic (uncharged) residue and the amount of red decreasing proportionally to the hydrophilicity.
